verdict.rationale: Zero's only programmatic surface is its own MCP server. Its documentation lists many inbox operations: reading threads, listing folders, composing and sending, drafts, deleting, bulk archive/delete, labels, read/unread and search. However, an independent check found no public HTTP API, no endpoint schema, and authentication only by copying a browser session cookie (OAuth 'coming soon'), and nothing documents parity with the UI. missing for 10: documented public REST/HTTP API with endpoint schema, explicit UI-parity coverage (e.g. settings, multi-provider account connection, customization), proper programmatic auth (OAuth/API keys), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails
Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails
Get all user labels - Create new custom labels with custom colors - Delete existing labels
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
